posts.title: Video: My Triumphant Return to Portland Vlogging! (A Day in the Life)
posts.description: It's been two long years… Now I'm excited about the new technology of streaming video podcasting and ready to film my PNW adventures large and small. Watch the Video Here
The new Pixelfed is here on iOS! And I’m excited to be using this new post composer. It’s so-o-o much better than before. I’m at Sewallcrest Park here in SE #Portland and enjoying the Fall colors. 🤩
